subject.title: fix: antml:/mm: namespaced tool-call XML leaks into chat replies (#97750)

question: Should OpenClaw expose `preserveCodeRegions` as a public `stripPlainTextToolCallBlocks` SDK option, or keep code-aware stripping only on internal delivery paths for this fix?
rationale: The branch preserves the strict default, but adding a public plugin SDK option is a durable API direction choice that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept the SDK opt-in
options.body: Keep the additive `StripPlainTextToolCallOptions` surface because it gives plugin callers an explicit way to preserve Markdown examples while preserving strict default scrubbing.

options.title: Keep it internal only
options.body: Remove the public option and leave code-aware behavior limited to internal delivery call sites, avoiding a new SDK contract at the cost of no plugin-facing escape hatch.

recommendation.title: Accept the SDK opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the additive `StripPlainTextToolCallOptions` surface because it gives plugin callers an explicit way to preserve Markdown examples while preserving strict default scrubbing.

likelyOwner.reason: The GitHub history shows recent ownership of both plugin SDK helper contracts and provider stream/shared text surfaces, making this the best available API-direction owner.
